lines.text: In a psalm for the choirmaster, Asaph asks the LORD whether He will forget him forever.
He asks how long he must wrestle in his soul and how long his enemy will dominate him.
He asks for light to his eyes, lest he sleep in death and his foes rejoice.
He says he has trusted in the LORD's mighty men, and his heart will rejoice in His salvation.
He will sing to the LORD, for the LORD has been good to him.
